<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsd:schema xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/529b51c9-7c3e-4e93-af78-47f9defe4c76.xsd" xmlns:ibmbpm="http://lombardi.ibm.com/schema/" targetNamespace="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/529b51c9-7c3e-4e93-af78-47f9defe4c76.xsd">
  <xsd:element name="createOrderRequest" type="createOrderRequest"/>
  <xsd:element name="createOrderResponse" type="createOrderResponse"/>
  <xsd:complexType name="createOrderRequest">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element name="account_id" type="xsd:string"/>
      <xsd:element name="date" type="xsd:date">
        <xsd:annotation format="date"/>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element default="Draft" minOccurs="0" name="status" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true"/>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element name="Pricebook2Id" type="xsd:string"/>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="createOrderResponse">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="createOrder" type="createOrder_200Type" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='createOrderResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='createOrder']">
        <xsd:annotation alternateOldName="createOrder_200" optional="true" responseCode="200">
          <xsd:documentation>Order created successfully</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="createOrder_200Type">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="order_id" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true">
          <xsd:documentation>ID of the newly created order</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
</xsd:schema>
